scope_transfers.authority: PM directive 2026-07-30 (close the residual production-credential exposure)
scope_transfers.reason: UTV2-1630 retained this job as a read-only production consumer and pinned scripts/shadow-scoring-runner.ts to the merge base. The pin named one file while that file statically imported apps/api/src/server.js. Measured on origin/main: the runner's static import closure is 220 project files, 129 of which sit inside this workflow's own pull_request trigger paths (65 under apps/api/src, 120 under packages/domain/src). The workflow therefore both fired because a PR edited packages/domain and executed that PR's domain code against production with the service-role key, at module-evaluation time, before --dry-run was parsed. Closed by making the apps/api imports dynamic and confined to the non-dry-run path, reducing the closure to 4 files and 0 trigger-path files, then pinning that whole closure.
scope_transfers.follow_up: The service-role key cannot simply be downgraded here: all 121 public tables have RLS enabled and pick_candidates/market_universe carry zero policies, so an anon key returns count=0 for exactly the tables the check counts and the workflow treats candidatesScanned=0 as a WARNING. Real reduction needs a pg_read_all_data role on production — a CREATE ROLE the orchestrator owns.

scope_transfers.reason: The job holds a production SUPERUSER Postgres URL and exported it into $GITHUB_ENV, which is job-wide: supabase start, supabase db reset, pg_isready, supabase stop and upload-artifact all inherited a live production connection string they have no use for. The composite action now also publishes the value as a step output, and out-env: '' suppresses the job-wide export, so only the two steps that read the live catalog receive it.

Dormant workflow carrying a SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN management-API credential — the broadest credential in the repository, scoped to the whole Supabase organisation rather than one project. Deleted rather than exempted: migration replay is already proven more strongly by live-schema-parity.yml, which applies every repo migration to a fresh local stack. scripts/ops/ci-proof.ts was repointed at that workflow so the control it asserts stays backed by something that exists.
